extracted.name: Old Fashioned Hamburger Hotdish
extracted.description: This hearty blend of ground beef, vegetables, and beef broth is not only easy to assemble, but it also packs a wallop of flavor that will bring the entire family back to the dinner table. Plus, with just a few simple ingredients, you can have your Old Fashioned Hamburger Hotdish from preparation to table in a little over an hour https://recipesmadewithlove.com/old-fashioned-hamburger-hotdish/
instruction_lines: In a Dutch oven add oil, onion and celery and sauté over medium heat for 6-8 minutes.
Stir in the garlic and cook for another minute.
Add the ground beef to the Dutch oven and cook, until it's browned (about 10 minutes).
Sprinkle in the flour and cook for 1-2 minutes.

Add in the broth, Worcestershire sauce, and potatoes. Increase the heat to high and bring it to a boil. Reduce the heat to a rapid simmer and cook, covered, stirring occasionally, for at least 30 minutes or until the potatoes are tender.
Add in carrots, peas, and corn. Transfer the hotdish to a small granite roaster pan and bake at 350° for 1 hour.
Season with salt and pepper to taste and serve warm.
